
func (s *Server) handlePageFeedGETStream(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if !s.checkIsDSReq(w, r) {
		return
	}

	var signals 
	if err := datastar.ReadSignals(r, &signals); err != nil {
		s.httpErrBad(w, "reading signals", err)
		return
	}

	dispatchOpen := func(
		e1 testapp.EventPostsCreated,
	) error {
		{
			j, err := json.Marshal(e1)
			if err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("marshaling EventPostsCreated JSON: %w", err)
			}
			err = s.messageBroker.Publish(context.WithoutCancel(r.Context()), s.messageBrokerMetrics, EvSubjPostsCreated, j)
			if err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("publishing subject %q: %w", EvSubjPostsCreated, err)
			}
		}
		return nil
	}

	dispatchClosed := func(
		e1 testapp.EventPostsCreated,
	) error {
		{
			j, err := json.Marshal(e1)
			if err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("marshaling EventPostsCreated JSON: %w", err)
			}
			err = s.messageBroker.Publish(context.WithoutCancel(r.Context()), s.messageBrokerMetrics, EvSubjPostsCreated, j)
			if err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("publishing subject %q: %w", EvSubjPostsCreated, err)
			}
		}
		return nil
	}

	p := testapp.PageFeed{
	App: s.app,
}
	s.handleStreamRequest(w, r, evSubjPageFeed(),
	func(
		streamID uint64,
		sse *datastar.ServerSentEventGenerator,
	) error {
		return p.StreamOpen(r, streamID, sse, signals, dispatch)
	},
	func(streamID uint64) {
		if err := p.StreamClose(r, streamID, dispatch); err != nil {
			s.logErr("handling PageFeed.StreamClose", err)
		}
	},
	func(
		streamID uint64,
		sse *datastar.ServerSentEventGenerator, ch <-chan msgbroker.Message,
	) {
		for range ch {
		}
	})
}
